items.statement: Slide 4 body and the Fig. 3 caption are updated to barrel σ_t = 72 ± 3 ps, with endcap left at 100 ± 5 ps.
items.how_to_judge: held when both the Slide 4 body and the Fig. 3 caption give barrel 72 ± 3 ps, not_held when either still gives 85 ± 4 ps or the caption is not addressed.

items.statement: The derived barrel π/K separation at 2 GeV/c is recomputed (138/72 ≈ 1.9σ) or explicitly flagged as needing recomputation.
items.how_to_judge: held when Slide 6 gives about 1.9σ for the barrel (1.9–2.0 acceptable) or flags the 1.6σ as stale, not_held when 1.6σ remains as the barrel value without comment.

items.statement: The Fig. 5 caption is updated: barrel curve for σ_t = 72 ps, and the 3σ crossing momentum recomputed (≈1.6 GeV/c) or flagged as needing recomputation.
items.how_to_judge: held when the Fig. 5 caption no longer says 85 ps for the barrel and the 3σ crossing is either about 1.6 GeV/c or explicitly flagged (and the figure itself flagged for regeneration), not_held when the caption keeps 85 ps or the 1.5 GeV/c crossing without comment.

items.statement: The summary slide is updated: barrel σ_t = 72 ps, barrel separation ≈1.9σ at 2 GeV/c, 3σ reach ≈1.6 GeV/c (or flagged).
items.how_to_judge: held when Slide 8 carries the new barrel σ_t and the recomputed (or flagged) separation and 3σ reach, not_held when any of 85 ps, 1.6σ or 1.5 GeV/c remains there as the current barrel value.

items.statement: The speaker notes are updated: the margin to the 90 ps target becomes 18 ps and the 'thin margin' message is revised.
items.how_to_judge: held when the notes give an 18 ps margin (or flag the 5 ps as stale) and no longer tell the speaker that the margin is thin, not_held when the 5 ps / thin-margin note is kept unchanged.

items.statement: Backup B1 barrel row is updated to σ_t = 72 ± 3 ps; endcap row unchanged.
items.how_to_judge: held when the revised B1 lists barrel 72 ± 3 ps and endcap 100 ± 5 ps, not_held when the barrel row still lists 85 ± 4 ps or B1 is not addressed.

items.statement: Backup B2 (per-run barrel values) is flagged as pre-fix / awaiting reprocessing, or removed with a note, since the update gives no per-run values.
items.how_to_judge: held when the output marks B2 as stale (pre-fix values, to be redone) or drops it with an explicit note, not_held when B2 is kept unchanged as if current, or silently deleted.

items.statement: Endcap values are untouched: σ_t = 100 ± 5 ps and separation 1.4σ at 2 GeV/c.
items.how_to_judge: held when every endcap value (Slide 4, Fig. 3, Fig. 5, Slide 6, Slide 8, B1) stays at 100 ± 5 ps / 1.4σ, not_held when any endcap value is changed.

items.statement: Other unaffected values and labels survive: efficiency 98.7 ± 0.3%, noise 0.8 Hz/cm², σ_T0 = 30 ps, L = 1.5 m, Δt = 138 ps, 90 ps design target, the Slide 7 limitations, and the PRELIMINARY / synthetic labels.
items.how_to_judge: held when all of these appear unchanged wherever restated and the labels and limitations are kept, not_held when any of them is altered or dropped.

items.statement: No stale barrel value survives as current: 85 ps (barrel), 1.6σ (barrel), 3σ at 1.5 GeV/c, 5 ps margin.
items.how_to_judge: held when none of these appears as a current barrel value in any slide, caption, note or B1 (B2 explicitly marked pre-fix and 'was 85 ps' mentions are fine), not_held otherwise.

items.statement: No invented numbers: no fabricated per-run reprocessed σ_t values, no new uncertainty on the separation, no new efficiency or module values.
items.how_to_judge: held when every new number comes from the update note or is derived from given numbers (separation, 3σ reach, margin), not_held when e.g. new per-run values for runs 101–104 or an unsourced uncertainty are produced.

items.statement: The summary gives efficiency 97.8% while Slide 5 and Backup B1 give 98.7 ± 0.3%; the output reports this pre-existing inconsistency.
items.how_to_judge: held when the output points out the 97.8% vs 98.7% mismatch (correcting it with a note or asking), not_held when it is not mentioned, including when silently changed.
items.locator_hint: Slide 8 bullet 2 vs Slide 5 / Backup B1
